definitions.meaning: watchful care, taking charge, taking care that a thing be not damaged

quotations.old_english: þám mynstre fore wæs mid geornlicre heordnysse
On hú mycelre Godes heordnysse (custodia) beóð þá þe cunnon hí sylfe forseón on þysum lífe
Þá þá hé nam þá hyrdnysse (hiordnisse, v. l.) þæs regollican lifes in þám mynstre
quotations.latin: cum in monasterio regularis vitae custodiam teneret

definitions.meaning: a watch, guard to prevent evil
a watch, period during which watch is kept

source_text: hird-ness. Add: I. watchful care, taking charge, taking care that a thing be not damaged :-- þám mynstre fore wæs mid geornlicre heordnysse monasterio solerti custodia praefuit, Gr. D. 52, 15. On hú mycelre Godes heordnysse (custodia) beóð þá þe cunnon hí sylfe forseón on þysum lífe, 39, 30. Þá þá hé nam þá hyrdnysse (hiordnisse, v. l.) þæs regollican lifes in þám mynstre cum in monasterio regularis vitae custodiam teneret, 104, 2. II. a watch, guard to prevent evil :-- Ic gesette mínum múþe heordnesse posui ori meo custodiam R. Ben. 21, 11. III. a watch, period during which watch is kept: -þúsend
